record.question: Any person who contravenes the provisions of The Mizoram Prevention of Malpractices Act may be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to THREE months or with fine which may extend to _____.
options: One Thousand Rupees or with both.
record.explanation: Printed page 2 of the Oct-2022 Head Master (Middle School) LDE Paper-III matches the bank stem and options exactly, including the capitalised 'THREE months' and the first option's 'or with both' wording that the other three options lack. The statute referred to is the Mizoram Prevention of Malpractices at Examination Act, 1990 (Act No. 11 of 1990, assented 13 August 1990): Section 3(2) punishes a paper setter who contravenes it with 'imprisonment for a term which may extend to THREE months or with fine which may extend to one thousand rupees or with both', and Sections 4(2), 5(2), 6(2) and 7 repeat the same one-thousand-rupee fine. Hence the blank is filled by One Thousand Rupees or with both.
